about: The patient describes primary prevention, but a previous stroke of unknown type leaves the finding possible until its type and the indication are reconciled.
Possible finding: the directions give half a 300 mg aspirin tablet daily (150 mg), and the record holds no line about either Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease or Reason for regular aspirin use.
Cartia (low-dose aspirin) is supplied eight times, but the record shows a heart attack, so the aspirin is for secondary prevention and there is no finding.
